title: Validate final legacy CCP applicability catalog
description:
Scope: final applicability catalog in /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/test/vectors/README.md and CCP2 corpus metadata under /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/test/vectors/. Reconcile the completed preserved-file inventory and provenance/reuse classifications into an explicit applicability map. Independently compare file/case/version sets, provenance references and catalog links so no relevant legacy family is omitted, counted twice or silently promoted to active CCP2 conformance. This is final catalog validation, not another inventory/provenance investigation. No legacy fixture regeneration, deletion, test weakening or production implementation is permitted.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Use vectors.10.inventory for preserved file facts and vectors.10.provenance for oracle/reuse decisions, then validate their joined applicability record. Keep the original schema-contract prerequisite and do not recreate the surviving classification parent.
acceptance_criteria: The final catalog accounts for the exact preserved inventory and every provenance classification, with consistent file/version/case references and explicit independent-primitive, legacy-policy, regression, conflicting or undrivable applicability. Local schema, link and set-equality checks catch missing or contradictory entries; preserved fixture byte digests still match the inventory. Existing valid legacy test obligations remain listed rather than skipped to obtain CCP2 success. Catalog claims cite verified reuse evidence, not issue closure, and no existing claim/status is changed by this task definition.
